metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for working on and with autologger. Every plugin ships a TypeScript CLI run via npx, and its skills call that CLI.

plugins.name: autologger-mcp
plugins.description: Read and write autologger session data (studios, shows, sessions, events, transcripts, topics, wiki pages, dashboards) through autologger's MCP endpoint: OAuth sign-in, token refresh, MCP tool calls and a wiki-link checker, all in a TypeScript CLI.

plugins.name: autologger-specs
plugins.description: Keeps autologger's docs/specs in step with code: which specs cover a file, which are stale against the specs-with-code gate, spec scaffolding and lint, and the repo's own spec gates.

plugins.name: plugin-advisor
plugins.description: Tracks recurring friction with the marketplace plugins (CLI failures, workarounds, manual steps, missing guidance) in a local redacted log, and drafts a suggested plugin change with a paste-ready /factory:run request once an issue recurs.

plugins.name: plugin-builder
plugins.description: Builds new autologger-marketplace plugins the convention's way: scaffolds a plugin from the template, checks a plugin against the CLI convention with actionable findings, and runs its full verification gate.

plugins.name: autologger-dev
plugins.description: Brings up a local autologger dev stack (local OpenBao, HTTPS mode, the dev CA) and connects Claude to its MCP server: a doctor that diagnoses what is missing, a guarded up, the CA export, status and connect steps, all in a TypeScript CLI.
